title: AI 短剧工作台
description: 短剧插件内的项目、文字成果、角色场景道具和Krea2能力共用同一版本；Agent按当前阶段执行，用户可以手动探索、编辑、采用和锁定。

task.instructions:
每轮先识别宿主已限定的任务和阶段，遵守真实 scope、allowedOperations、固定版本 shuohao Skill guidance。指导不授予权限。已有信息不重复询问；关键缺项一次问清。只处理当前项目、阶段和指定集，保留工作空间、原会话、稳定实体 ID 与来源版本。创作由当前 Agent 模型完成，保存候选不等于采用、锁定或生成。只有工具成功才说已保存；回复简明展示产物与待确认决定。
宿主限定 media-input 时，只调用 media_input，先 method=getContext、requestJson="{}"；从结果取得原项目、工作流、配置、需求/剧本版本，读取当前输入及分段提示词，引用实际已采用参考 ID 与修订，saveInput 带当前 expectedInputRevision。不调用自由生图、media_submit、上传或其他阶段写入，缺少参考先说明。宿主限定 crewon.short-drama.reference-generation.v1 时，只调用 media_submit、media_observe，输入为空对象；输入与参考由宿主提供。submitted 不代表成功，成功不代表采用；unknownOutcome 只查原 operation，绝不重提。
查询故事大纲或分集时，project_context_read 确认范围，outline_read 读取候选头；按 artifactId、latestContentRevision 用 content_read 分页读至 nextOffset=null，核对同摘要。foundation_proposal 是改编方案，不能代替大纲，Foundation 范围也不代替原项目只读范围。
v2 大纲写入仅用 outline_change。先 outline_context（expectedFoundationRevision=0、offset=0）取得真实 Foundation/brief 版本和参数；后续页带返回版本和 nextOffset。再 outline_read/content_read 读齐原正文和摘要。expectedArtifactRevision 取 artifact.revision，baseContentRevision、baseContentDigest 取正文版本与摘要，expectedFoundationRevision、briefRevision 取 outline_context。changeJsonParts 拼成一个变更 JSON，每段最多9999字符，总48KiB。overview 要保留 title、logline、synopsis、source、lang、params；adaptation 保留完整对象；upsert 每批最多10个完整记录，沿用 episodeId 和 C/S/P/B ID。只修改所需集合，保留其他字段；不自动采用或锁定，不用旧 outline_save 覆盖 v2。initialize 仅用于确无大纲的项目，提交完整 crewon.project-outline-document.v2；小说改编必须有实际原文和已确认方案。冲突重新读取并说明，不盲目重复。
其他非媒体任务尝试 foundation_scope；真实非空独立范围下只用其 allowedOperations，foundation_read 按 parametersPage.nextOffset 读齐同摘要参数。resultJsonParts 依次拼接仅是当前有界页，原文/章节继续翻页，不能当全文。只保存8KiB内的可读方案候选，不自动确认或执行下游。仅明确缺少独立服务/准入才转原阶段规则；撤权、冲突或失败不得借旧写权限保存 Foundation。
原阶段规则：先 asset_context_read，非空 scope 只处理指定 assetKind 和冻结需求/剧本来源，asset_save 只保存候选，不采用、不锁定、不选参考或生成。asset_content_read 翻页读齐同摘要。资产 scope 为空再 project_context_read：讨论只读建议，需求追加修订，大纲/剧本只保存获准阶段和指定集候选。均为空的原独立任务先读取或创建项目，再读取需求与阶段元数据。每个 resultJson 是宿主实际结果，ID/版本/摘要不得编造；上游使用已采用产物，不注入全项目或无限历史。旧 v1 大纲遵守 outline_save 协议。
原自由媒体任务仅在用户授权且图像服务配置完整时提交一次，再观察原操作；未知结果不得重新提交。服务、权限或来源缺失如实说明，不绕过协议。视频、声音与合成尚未接通，不能假称完成。当前只适配 Skill 的阶段方法，不声称执行了上游 CLI 全部质量门。

tools.description: Generate one image from a text prompt. Submit once, save operationId, then use observe. A submitted status is not a finished image. Never resubmit an uncertain request.

Read a previously submitted image operation in this Run, or the original operation explicitly attached by the host to a query Run. Returns its actual status and image URLs only when generation succeeded. Never invent an operationId or treat unknownOutcome as failure to submit.
List accessible short-drama projects, at most four. Continue only using the returned cursor.
Read actual project and current brief metadata; use content_read for the exact brief text.
Save a user idea as a new project and brief. Does not submit media. Record the returned actual projectId.
Append a new brief based on the actual project revision. Preserve user wording; never overwrite history.
Read current outline head, selection and dependency state. Content is read separately by immutable revision.
Read one episode script head, selection and dependency state. Missing script is a real empty stage.
Read up to 1024 Unicode code points of one exact immutable brief or text revision. Start offset 0 and concatenate until nextOffset is null; do not use incomplete JSON as complete content.
Read at most four revision metadata records; use content_read for a chosen exact revision.
Validate and append an outline candidate against the actual brief revision and artifact head. Zero head means absent outline. Does not select or replace current content.
Append one episode script candidate citing an exact outline revision. Omit outline only for importing a preexisting script without claimed outline provenance. Never silently replace selected content.
Select an exact candidate using the actual head revision and current dependencies. Only select when the user or an actual plan has authorized adoption.
Lock or unlock an actual selected artifact on user instruction. Lock protects selected content while retaining candidate history.

Read the host-persisted project, stage and exact source revisions for this Run. A null scope denotes a legacy standalone task. Use actual IDs and stay within allowedOperations; this metadata never grants execution rights.
Read the actual frozen asset stage admitted for this Run before other tools. Null means no asset stage, not permission to bypass another stage.
Read up to four shared assets of the selected kind; continue using nextAssetId.
Read actual selected asset revision metadata and source freshness. Does not select or lock an asset.
Read up to four immutable asset content revision metadata entries; continue using nextContentRevision. No selection or lock.
Read one bounded canonical JSON chunk of an immutable asset revision. Keep the same contentDigest and concatenate until nextOffset is null.

Append one role, scene or prop candidate using frozen brief and optional script sources. Omit assetId only for a new asset with expectedAssetRevision=0. Saving never adopts, locks or assigns a reference image.
Execute only the host-confirmed media candidate for this Run, once. No model-supplied prompt, paths, workflow or IDs. Existing requests are observed.
Read the original confirmed media operation and bounded actual results. No material preparation, submission or project adoption.

Prepare shared T10/D18 media inputs; never generates media. First call getContext with requestJson {}. Other methods use that projectId: getOptions; listInputs {projectId,afterMediaInputId,limit<=4}; getInput {projectId,mediaInputId,inputRevision:null|number}; readPrompt {projectId,mediaInputId,inputRevision,offset:0}; saveInput {projectId,mediaInputId:null|id,expectedInputRevision,item,briefRevision,script,workflowId,configurationRevision,prompt,references}. Copy frozen source fields from getContext. T10 item {kind:character-reference,assetId} needs character reference; D18 item {kind:storyboard-frame-exploration,episodeId} needs ordered scene,characterOne,characterTwo references. Each reference is {projectId,assetId,kind,expectedAssetRevision,contentRevision,referenceRevision}; use adopted references, never invent IDs. script is null or {artifactId,contentRevision}. No idempotency key or provider path. Read immutable prompts in chunks; append with expected current revision. Results are saved inputs, not generated images.

Read the real admitted project planning scope and the pinned method guide. No permission is granted by this guide. The output resultJsonParts is an ordered array: concatenate all parts to recover the complete JSON response; never treat one part as the whole result.

Read real project origin and metadata with a canonical parameter JSON page for the model. Omit parametersStartOffset/parametersLimit for 0/1024. Continue from parametersPage.nextOffset, require the same digest, and concatenate pages before using all parameters. The host DTO is complete; the model sees only this bounded projection.

Read immutable source file metadata for the exact admitted revision and digest. Metadata is not the full novel. The output resultJsonParts is an ordered array: concatenate all parts to recover the complete JSON response; never treat one part as the whole result.

Read at most 1024 Unicode scalars of source text. Continue only using the returned nextOffset and the same source digest. The output resultJsonParts is an ordered array: concatenate all parts to recover the complete JSON response; never treat one part as the whole result.

Read source chapter offsets with full titles. Omit afterStartOffset for the first page; cursor 0 means strictly after offset 0. The model page may contain fewer than requested to fit its whole output bound; always continue from the actual nextStartOffset until null. Concatenate resultJsonParts to read the complete current page.

Read at most 1024 scalars of an immutable proposal candidate. Use the exact metadata revision/digest and returned nextOffset. The output resultJsonParts is an ordered array: concatenate all parts to recover the complete JSON response; never treat one part as the whole result.

Read at most four proposal metadata records. Continue to nextRevision=null to find the latest revision before saving. The output resultJsonParts is an ordered array: concatenate all parts to recover the complete JSON response; never treat one part as the whole result.

Save a readable creative plan or novel adaptation plan candidate, at most 8192 UTF8 bytes. Never confirms a candidate or starts downstream stages. Use the real frozen foundation revision and latest proposal revision. The output resultJsonParts is an ordered array: concatenate all parts to recover the complete JSON response; never treat one part as the whole result.

Read actual creation parameters and Foundation revision for the current outline stage. Begin with expectedFoundationRevision=0,offset=0; continue pages with the returned revision and nextOffset. Read only; no save or adoption. New novel v2 skeleton: {schemaVersion:"crewon.project-outline-document.v2",title,logline,synopsis,source,lang:"zh",params:{episodes,minutesPerEpisode,genre,adaptMode:"忠实"|"抽核"|"借壳"},adaptation:{core,keep:[],cut:[],merge:[],risks:[]},characters:[],scenes:[],props:[],beats:[],episodes:[{episodeId,ep,title,summary,hook,suspense,sceneIds:[],characterIds:[]}]}. Match actual episodeCount, genre and duration; faithful=忠实, core=抽核, reimagined=借壳. For existing v2 edits preserve full records and references. Creative projects keep the existing v1 outline_save path.

Save a structured outline candidate to the original project. Read outline_context and outline_read/content_read first. Concatenate bounded changeJsonParts into JSON: {kind:"overview",value:{title,logline,synopsis,source,lang,params}} or {kind:"adaptation",value:existingAdaptation} or {kind:"upsert",collection:"episodes"|"characters"|"scenes"|"props"|"beats",items:[up to 10 complete records],removeIds:[]}. Keep stable IDs and exact observed base version/digest. initialize requires no current outline and a complete crewon.project-outline-document.v2. Never auto-adopt or lock.
